Description
The Perth Mint created this 1/2 Oz Silver Australian Lunar Horse Coin in 2014 as part of their Lunar Silver Coin Series. This new series installment honors 2014, the Year of the Horse. Unsurprisingly, collectors and investors are interested in the beautifully designed 2014 Australian Lunar Horse 1/2 oz Silver Coin. The Perth Mint’s Lunar Series includes this classy coin, which honors the Year of the Horse according to the Chinese Zodiac.
These coins are a fantastic method to increase the
silver
in your investment portfolio or even to give as presents to loved ones. One of the series’ highlights is the enduring horse design.
Design of 2014 Australian Lunar Horse 1/2 oz Silver Coin
Australian Silver Horse Coins are highly prized for their fine craftsmanship and excellent quality. Each of these
silver coins
contains half an ounce of pure silver.
Each 1/2 Oz Silver Australian Lunar Horse Coin is a two-horse scene, with one taking a drink from the stream and the other gazing off into the horizon. The Chinese character for the horse is imprinted on the coin, which has a background of trees. The words “Year of the Horse” are written beneath the stream. The obverse side of the coin features the words 2014, 50 Cents, Australia, Elizabeth II, Ounce, and.999 Silver written around a picture of Queen Elizabeth II wearing a crown.
Main Highlights of 1/2 Oz Silver Australian Lunar Horse Coin
Contains 1/2 oz of .999 fine silver.
Minted by Perth Mint in Australia.
Available in Brilliant Uncirculated condition.
Face value of $.50 (AUD) is fully backed by Australia’s government.
The Features a Lunar Horse design to commemorate the Chinese Lunar Calendar.
